web-guide-idea-41.audience: Students stuck on a topic you can explain well.
web-guide-idea-41.offer: Offer focused teaching on a defined concept. Work through reasoning and practice; do not complete assessed work for the learner.
web-guide-idea-41.steps.0: Ask for the topic and identify the sticking point.
web-guide-idea-41.steps.1: Explain with a fresh example and let the student try another.
web-guide-idea-41.steps.2: Review the reasoning and set a small independent practice task.
web-guide-idea-41.equipment: A phone with a paper-and-pen camera angle can work. A tablet or whiteboard is optional.
web-guide-idea-41.returnReason: Build on the next concept once understanding is clear. Repeat value comes from better reasoning, not dependence on answers.
web-guide-idea-41.promotion: Demonstrate a short explanation at the intended level and name the subject scope.
web-guide-idea-41.metadataTitle: Subject Doubt Clearing — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-41.metadataDescription: Explain a difficult topic and practise examples together, without completing assessed work for the student. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
